introduce:
Start on hands and knees. Put your knees and toes together.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, sit your hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward. Rest your forehead, soften your elbows, and lower your chest close to the floor.

Breathe slowly through your nose; with each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Inhale to allow your belly to expand into your thighs. Exhale to soften into the pose.

introduce: Lie on the floor with your feet together. Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together. Let your knees fall comfortably out to the sides, moving them toward the floor. \n\nPlace your hands by your sides or on your belly, and begin to breathe slowly and deeply through your nose. Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to allow your knees to sink closer to the floor.
name: LYING BUTTERFLY STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
You should feel a stretch in your groin.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your knees down.
Try to let your knees get closer and closer to the floor.

introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the left, keeping shoulders grounded. 

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.
name: LYING TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your body. Exhale to deepen the twist.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the right, keeping shoulders grounded.

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.
name: LYING TWIST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your body. Exhale to deepen the twist.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

introduce:
Lie down on your back with your legs extended. Relax your spine and gently press your lower back into the floor. 

Inhale, lift your knees toward your chest. Exhale, hug your knees gently.

Hold the position without holding your breath. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. Exhale as you soften your shoulders and hips.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your shoulders and hips.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your right knee, and grab the back of your right thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your right ankle on your left knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your left knee, and grab the back of your left thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Start on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

Inhale, bring your left knee forward, and place your left knee behind your left wrist on the ground. Exhale, slide your right leg back, extending it straight behind you.

Put your forearms on the ground in front of your leg. 

Hold for a few seconds. Inhale to lengthen your spine forward. Exhale, release tension in your left hip.
name: PIGEON POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Your front knee should be in line with the outside of your shoulder.
You should not feel any discomfort.
This exercise helps to make your muscle groups more flexible.
This exercise helps to reduce sciatic pain.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to soften your left hip to open.

introduce:
Start on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

Inhale, bring your right knee forward, and place your right knee behind your right wrist on the ground. Exhale, slide your left leg back, extending it straight behind you.

Put your forearms on the ground in front of your leg. 

Hold for a few seconds. Inhale to lengthen your spine forward. Exhale, release tension in your right hip.
name: PIGEON POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Your front knee should be in line with the outside of your shoulder.
You should not feel any discomfort.
This exercise helps to make your muscle groups more flexible.
This exercise helps to reduce sciatic pain.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to soften your right hip to open.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Bend your arms forward and rest your hands gently on your forehead.

Inhale, gently arch your lower back, allowing a subtle lift while keeping your tailbone grounded. Exhale as you press your lower back into the mat, closing the gap.

Repeat with smooth and steady breaths.
name: THE NO-GAP

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Squeeze your glutes and flatten your lower back on the ground.
This exercise can help fix the anterior pelvic tilt.
Inhale to return and relax your back. Exhale to press your lower back down.

introduce: Lie flat on your back with legs extended wider than hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides, palms up. \n\nInhale slowly through your nose, your spine gently lengthening and your body becoming light. Exhale fully, allowing your shoulders, hips, and entire body to melt into the mat, and consciously relax any areas of tightness or tension throughout your body.
name: RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Close your eyes, relax your arms and legs, relax your face, relax the ankles.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to release tension of your body.
Let any weight, any tension relax to the earth, feel the floor below you, supporting you.
Let every part of your body relax and lower to the ground.
Invite rest and peace into your mind, body and soul.

introduce:
Sit with the soles of your feet together. Draw your heels towards your hips, and gently press your knees down.

Exhale, hinge forward from your hips, reaching your hands toward the floor. 

Hold this position. Inhale to lift and extend through your spine, exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.
name: EASY BUTTERFLY POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Press your knees down as much as possible.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.
Keep your sit bones down.
You should feel the stretch in your thighs.
This position can open up your hips and thighs.
This position helps stretch your thighs.

introduce: Sit on the floor with your feet hip width apart. Lift your arms at shoulder height, curl your chin towards your chest. Reach your hands forward to touch your toes, then return and repeat.\n\nExhale as you reach forward, and inhale as you return. This exercise stretches your calves, hamstrings and back.
name: FORWARD SPINE STRETCH PULSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Exhale as you reach forward, and inhale as you return.
Pull your toes toward your body.
Bring your shoulders down away from your ears.
This exercise stretches your calves, hamstrings and back.

introduce:
Start on your knees and elbows. Place your elbows under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. 

Drop your head on the floor, and put your hands on the top of your head. Round your spine while keeping your upper back still. 

Inhale, and drop your pelvis down. Exhale, and round your spine. Repeat the exercise.
name: LUMBAR CAT COW

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your upper back still during exercise.
Inhale as you drop your pelvis down, and exhale as you round your spine.
This exercise can mobilize your lumbar spine.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs extended. Spread your arms out to the sides with your palms down on the ground.

Lift your left leg off the floor and cross it over to your right side, trying to touch your toes to the floor.

Return to the starting position, and repeat with the other side.
name: PRONE SCORPION KICKS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please exercise within your range of motion to avoid straining your lower back.
This exercise stretches your hip flexors and lower back.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Sit on the floor with knees bent. Hold your shins and draw your knees toward your chest.

Inhale to roll back, keeping your spine rounded. Exhale as you roll forward toward your knees.

Repeat the pose with a steady breathing rhythm.
name: SPINAL ROLLING

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your spine rounded.
Engage your core to keep balance.
Don\'t roll back too far on your neck.
Keep the movement controlled.
Inhale to roll back. Exhale to roll forward.
This exercise can loosen up your spine and relieve your back pain.

introduce:
Sit upright on the floor. Bend your left leg with your heel close to your sit bone. Extend your right leg forward. Put your left hand on the floor behind you for support. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, twist your upper body to the left. Bend your right elbow and hook it on the outside of your left knee, fingers pointing upward. Turn your gaze over your left shoulder.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine. With each exhale, gently rotate your body deeper into the twist.
name: SAGE MARICHI'S POSE Ⅲ LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs still when twisting your body.
Twist from your waist instead of your chest.
Evenly distribute your weight between both sit bones.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
If sitting upright is challenging, place a block under your buttocks.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, chest, and spine.
This exercise helps relieve your back and hip pain.

introduce:
Sit upright on the floor. Bend your right leg with your heel close to your sit bone. Extend your left leg forward. Put your right hand on the floor behind you for support. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, twist your upper body to the right. Bend your left elbow and hook it on the outside of your right knee, fingers pointing upward. Turn your gaze over your right shoulder.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine. With each exhale, gently rotate your body deeper into the twist.
name: SAGE MARICHI'S POSE Ⅲ RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs still when twisting your body.
Twist from your waist instead of your chest.
Evenly distribute your weight between both sit bones.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
If sitting upright is challenging, place a block under your buttocks.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, chest, and spine.
This exercise helps relieve your back and hip pain.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned outward. 

Inhale, bring your hands together into a prayer position at your chest. Exhale, bend your knees and lower your hips as much as possible. Press your elbows against your inner knees to open up your hips. 

Keep your heels on the floor; if needed, place a rolled-up towel under them.

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.
name: GARLAND POSE

tips.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.
This exercise stretches your groins, lower back, and hips.
This exercise strengthens and stretches your ankles.

introduce:
Lie on your back and inhale. Exhale to draw your knees toward your chest, separate the knees, and raise the feet so the soles of the feet are toward the ceiling.

Inhale, grab the inside of your feet. Exhale, gently sink the shoulders and tailbone toward the floor.

Hold the position. Inhale to lengthen the spine, exhale to soften your hips and lower back into the mat.
name: HAPPY BABY POSE

tips.text: Please do this on the mat.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to soften your hips and lower back.
Keep your head on the mat to avoid neck strain.
This exercise can help relieve your lower back pain.
This exercise stretches your inner thighs, hamstrings, groin, and spine.
